name: Seekers
overview: Scripture emphasizes the earnest and wholehearted pursuit of the LORD as essential for experiencing His presence and salvation. Passages such as Deuteronomy 4:29 and 1 Chronicles 28:9 reveal that seeking God with all one’s heart and soul leads to finding Him, while forsaking Him results in rejection. The call to continually seek the LORD’s strength and face, as seen in 1 Chronicles 16:11, and the example of those who set their hearts to seek God in 2 Chronicles 11:16, underscore the importance of deliberate, ongoing devotion. This pursuit is both a personal commitment and a communal responsibility, involving dedication to God’s purposes and worship.
